messages:
maria: Draft Spark Sheet for CISOs / Q2 launch — short, single-page handout for field + AE use. Goal: security + SLAs + deploy modes + a small benchmark blurb and clear inbound routing. Uploaded draft in Drive: https://drive.redwood/enterprise/spark-sheet-draft

sam: Nice start. Can we add a 2-line competitor comparison? just a 1-2 bullet visual.

alex: For benchmark copy, keep it non-technical. Proposed blurb: 'Typical optimized config: 95th pctl latency ~120ms (hosted), throughput ~120 req/s per GPU, unit cost ~ $1.8 per 1k tokens — can be improved with caching/quantization.'

jamal: Routing notes — inbound should set Intercom tag `enterprise-spark`, route to Field AE queue + Priority Tier 2. Webinar CTA link: https://redwood.ai/webinar/secure-serving-101

eva: Design requests: single-column one-pager, hero line + 3 chips (Security, SLAs, Deployment Modes). Keep icons monochrome. Need localized DE/FR/EN strings.

maria: SLA copy draft: 'Enterprise SLAs available. Typical production SLO: 99.9% uptime; median token latency in optimized configs <100ms; dedicated tiers for strict isolation.' Thoughts?

sam: Don't promise <100ms flat. Suggest: 'Median token latency: sub-100ms on optimized configs; production 95th pctl depends on model/profile.' :thinking_face:

alex: Add a one-line fallback note: 'Automatic fallback to compatible model variants maintains availability during capacity spikes.'

jamal: For inbound routing, here's the Intercom rule snippet — please confirm before I push:
```
if message.contains("enterprise" or "CISO" or "spark-sheet") then add_tag("enterprise-spark") and assign_queue("Field-AE-Enterprise")
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created doc version v1.2 at https://docs.redwood/enterprise/spark-sheet (revision: v1.2)

maria: I'll iterate language and finalize PDF by EOD. Jamal — please add the Intercom rule + Slack alert to #sales-enterprise when tag hits.

jamal: Confirmed — Intercom rule + Slack mapping will be live by 5pm PT. :thumbsup:

maria: Suggested outbound subject line for SDRs: `Secure serving for regulated apps — 2 min read`

sam: Email preview line: `How Redwood helps you meet SLAs and secure inference`

eva: Final design checklist: export @2x, include alt text for accessibility, provide 3 translations, add CTA button + small benchmark footnote.

maria: Perfect — I'll push final PDF + web asset and update the doc link when done. Thanks all!
